name: Assumption Test Card
deliverable: Scientific decomposition of hypotheses into verification tests and success thresholds

steps.text: Pick the assumption the plan depends on most and would hurt most if it turned out wrong.
Rewrite it as a measurable, falsifiable hypothesis.
Set the success threshold first, then design the smallest test that could contradict it.

failure: A test that can only confirm: leading questions and counted enthusiasm let the assumption survive.
intervention: Ask what result would prove the assumption wrong, then design the test so that result could actually appear.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A common lean experimentation practice; no single documented originator.
